title: Project
description: One compose project: summary, every container with its labels, and a click-through per container to the dashboard that fits its container.type (backend, frontend, db, cache, storage) or its runtime (container.lang).

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.description: Compose project. (standalone) = containers started without compose.

panels.title: Restarts (24h)
panels.description: Container restarts (CPU counter resets) in the last 24h.

panels.title: Error logs/min
panels.description: error, fatal and panic log lines per minute.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Container alerts (memory, restarts, gone) firing for this project.

panels.title: Containers — click one to open its dashboard

panels.description: Every container of the project. Click the container (or Opens) for its dashboard, lang for its runtime dashboard. Labels come from docker-compose: container.type / lang / team / env.
